title: F45 Training NZ Deals
meta_desc: Discover the latest F45 Training NZ deals and promotions for June 2026, including how to claim a free trial week and tips for getting the best deal.
intro: F45 Training NZ is a popular boutique gym offering high-intensity group training sessions. With prices ranging from $25.00 to $42.50 per week, it's considered a premium option. However, with the right deal, you can try it out without breaking the bank. Currently, F45 is offering a free trial week at any of their studios.

sections.heading: Current Promotions
sections.body: F45 Training NZ is currently offering a free trial week at any of their studios. This allows you to try out their high-intensity group training sessions, which are 45 minutes long, and see if it's the right fit for you. To claim this promotion, simply visit the F45 website and sign up for a free trial week. You'll get to experience the unique workout programme and community that F45 has to offer.
list: Try any F45 studio free for one week

sections.heading: Best Time to Join
sections.body: It's also worth noting that F45 Training NZ often offers discounts or promotions during holiday periods, such as Christmas or New Year's. These deals can be a great way to try out the gym and save some money in the process.

sections.heading: Joining Fee and Comparison to Exercise NZ Subsidy
sections.body: On the other hand, if you're looking for a premium boutique gym experience and are willing to pay for it, F45 Training NZ may still be a good choice. The high-intensity group training sessions and supportive community can be a great motivator for those who need it.

sections.heading: Tips for Getting the Best Deal
sections.body: To get the best deal at F45 Training NZ, consider the following tips:
list: Take advantage of the free trial week to try out the gym and see if it's the right fit for you
Look for limited-time offers and sales, which can provide significant savings
Consider joining during the off-season (usually October to May) for potential discounts or promotions
Compare prices and services with other gyms, including those that participate in the Exercise NZ subsidy programme
Negotiate with the gym staff to see if they can offer any additional discounts or perks
